wiki.title: Richard West (Missouri politician)
wiki.extract: Richard West is an American politician, businessman, and retired law enforcement officer. He is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives from the 102nd district. Prior to redistricting he represented the 63rd district, which consisted of parts of western St. Charles County and parts of eastern Warren County. West is a former mayor of New Melle, Missouri, and completed his 4th two-year mayoral term in 2022.
